notes: UFCStats.com could not be reached from the box on 2026-10-11 (connection timed out repeatedly for curl and headless Chrome; WebFetch got 403). Stats were taken from the official UFC.com stats feed (same FightMetric data UFCStats publishes). Validation: the same feed for UFC 332 matched the UFCStats-built UFC 332 file exactly for all 28 fighters (totals, sig strikes by target/position, every per-round line). ufcstats_url is null; ufcstats_name holds the UFC.com spelling (UFCStats uses the same feed names). Nothing is estimated; no stat field is null in this file.
Fighter order in each bout is red corner then blue corner (UFCStats order). judges_scores are fighters[0]-fighters[1] per judge; Wikipedia winner-perspective scores are in wikipedia_result.

Weight class/name fields use upcoming_card.json spelling (e.g. Loopy Godinez, Darya Zheleznyakova, Ernesta Kareckaitė); ufcstats_name is the UFC.com spelling (Daria Zhelezniakova, Ernesta Kareckaite).

Three catchweights after missed weight (Wikipedia/MMA Junkie weigh-ins): Godinez vs Ketlen Souza 117 lb (Souza +1), Prado vs Ismael Bonfim 163.5 lb (Bonfim +7.5), Franco vs Brendson Ribeiro 208.5 lb (Ribeiro +2.5). UFC.com feed still lists the nominal class.

Draw: Ernesta Kareckaitė vs Melissa Gatto ended in a majority draw (result D for both, winner null, method M-DEC). UFC.com scores Kareckaitė-Gatto: Mike Bell 28-28, Sal D'amato 28-28, Junichiro Kamijo 29-27; Kareckaitė lost a point in R1 for grabbing the fence (Wikipedia).
Point deductions: Christian Leroy Duncan -1 in R2 (eye poke) in the main event (Allen won by RNC R5 2:46); Kareckaitė -1 in R1.

Method-detail differences: Alice Pereira vs Darya Zheleznyakova is KO/TKO R1 5:00 on both; UFC.com note says "Zhelezniakova cut" (stoppage between rounds 1 and 2), Wikipedia says "TKO (retirement)". Tanzilovi finish: UFC.com "Kick to Head At Distance", Wikipedia "TKO (head kick and punches)". Winner, round and time match Wikipedia on all 12 bouts.

Walker vs Meerschaert moved from main card to prelims in the final bout order (BigMarcel24, Oct 6); card_segment follows UFC.com. Gerald Meerschaert announced his retirement after the loss (BigMarcel24 / Heavy, Oct 10).
Season 5 drafted_team on this card: none (no Season 5 drafted fighter competed; Arnold Allen ≠ Brendan Allen).
Raw data saved in /workspace/vegas122/ufcjson/ (fight JSON) and /workspace/vegas122/ev1344.json.
Fantasy points are NOT computed here; the app does that.
